tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen; also the inside of the servings stepper.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, list rows, search field, chips, round buttons and the bottom bar, on bg.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg and surface (13:1+ in both themes). As a fill: the secondary button, with bg as its text.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta lines, times, notes under ingredients, captions. On bg and surface (4.9:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between list rows, ingredient rows and spec-strip cells. Decorative only: never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The current accent, Raspberry by default. Primary actions (Add to plan, New recipe, the + of the stepper), active nav item, favorite heart, links. As text on bg, surface and accent-soft (4.5:1+ in both themes). The Accent color setting swaps accent, on-accent and accent-soft for one of the accent-* sets below.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill. Swapped with the accent set.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind accent text: quantity pills, step numbers, the active nav indicator. Swapped with the accent set.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 3:1+ on bg and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions only (Delete recipe, Clear list), always with a word, never color alone. Text on bg and surface.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind bottom sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: tag-mint
tokens.usage: Tag fill, mint family (e.g. Vegetarian). Always with tag-mint-ink.

tokens.name: tag-mint-ink
tokens.usage: Tag text on tag-mint (7:1+).

tokens.name: tag-butter
tokens.usage: Tag fill, butter family (e.g. Side, Sunday). Also the Notes card fill.

tokens.name: tag-butter-ink
tokens.usage: Text on tag-butter (7:1+).

tokens.name: tag-sky
tokens.usage: Tag fill, sky family (e.g. Weeknight).

tokens.name: tag-sky-ink
tokens.usage: Text on tag-sky (7:1+).

tokens.name: tag-peach
tokens.usage: Tag fill, peach family (e.g. Oven, Summer).

tokens.name: tag-peach-ink
tokens.usage: Text on tag-peach (7:1+).

tokens.name: accent-raspberry
tokens.usage: Raspberry accent set (default): the accent value. Text on bg, surface and accent-raspberry-soft passes 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-raspberry-on
tokens.usage: Raspberry accent set: text and icons on accent-raspberry.

tokens.name: accent-raspberry-soft
tokens.usage: Raspberry accent set: tinted fill behind accent-raspberry text.

tokens.name: accent-spirulina
tokens.usage: Spirulina accent set: the accent value. Text on bg, surface and accent-spirulina-soft passes 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-spirulina-on
tokens.usage: Spirulina accent set: text and icons on accent-spirulina.

tokens.name: accent-spirulina-soft
tokens.usage: Spirulina accent set: tinted fill behind accent-spirulina text.

tokens.name: accent-blueberry
tokens.usage: Blueberry accent set: the accent value. Text on bg, surface and accent-blueberry-soft passes 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-blueberry-on
tokens.usage: Blueberry accent set: text and icons on accent-blueberry.

tokens.name: accent-blueberry-soft
tokens.usage: Blueberry accent set: tinted fill behind accent-blueberry text.

tokens.name: accent-saffron
tokens.usage: Saffron accent set: the accent value. Text on bg, surface and accent-saffron-soft passes 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-saffron-on
tokens.usage: Saffron accent set: text and icons on accent-saffron.

tokens.name: accent-saffron-soft
tokens.usage: Saffron accent set: tinted fill behind accent-saffron text.

tokens.name: accent-basil
tokens.usage: Basil accent set (close to the mint tag family: fine, but tags lose some contrast with actions): the accent value. Text on bg, surface and accent-basil-soft passes 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-basil-on
tokens.usage: Basil accent set: text and icons on accent-basil.

tokens.name: accent-basil-soft
tokens.usage: Basil accent set: tinted fill behind accent-basil text.

styles.name: title-xl
styles.usage: Screen titles (Recipes) and the recipe name.

styles.name: title-l
styles.usage: Section headers inside a screen: Ingredients, Steps.

styles.name: title-m
styles.usage: Recipe names in list rows, card titles.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Add the potatoes and cook for 10 minutes over low heat.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, chips, ingredient names (16px variant: label-l).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines: time cooked, counts, sources.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Spec-strip labels and nav labels. Sentence case, never all caps.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Tag pills in lists (13px in the recipe header).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text in small pills, gaps inside the stepper.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips and between tag pills.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a thumbnail and its text; between cards in a stack.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margins; card and step-card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between sections of the recipe screen.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Top padding of screens and of the sheet over the photo.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large separations; bottom clearance above floating actions.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small overlays on images (favorite toggle on a card).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Thumbnails, step cards, the notes card.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Content cards: ingredients card, spec strip.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of the sheet that overlaps the recipe photo, and of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every control: buttons, chips, search field, pills, round buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Floating accent controls only: the New recipe button and Add to plan. Nothing else casts a shadow. In light mode the shadow is tinted with the current accent at 28% (the value shows Raspberry).

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target: chips, stepper buttons, small round buttons.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Search field; round buttons over a photo (48px visual inside).

tokens.name: size-cta
tokens.usage: New recipe button and bottom action buttons.

tokens.name: size-thumb
tokens.usage: Recipe thumbnails in the list.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Default icon size; 18–20px inside chips and pills.
